title: Refuse a multi-line paste into the secret prompt: drain and flush, and point docs at the file or stdin route (DEC-255 (a2)(3))
description: DEC-255 (a2) clause (3), read by ref from opum-doc origin/dev .quest/planning.json (0a9c0480) on 2026-11-03, verbatim: "Multi-line paste (WCLI-97 follow-up): when input is still queued after the terminator, REFUSE with a plain error, then drain and flush, consistent with secret-value.ts's bound refusal; docs point multi-line secrets to the file or stdin route. A post-tag follow-up, not a flip gate." Filed only; not started. The leader runs the dispatch floor on this id and then briefs it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: When input is still queued after the terminator, the prompt refuses with a plain error, then drains and flushes the queued input, and no queued byte reaches a later prompt or the shell
The refusal is consistent with the bound refusal in secret-value.ts
The docs point multi-line secrets to the file or stdin route

implementationNotes: Built to DEC-255 (a2)(3). src/adapters/secret-value.ts: after a hidden read returns a non-empty value, a new inputPending part (default inputQueued(0) in terminal-input.ts: isatty, then poll for one quiet interval, POLLIN with no ERR/HUP/NVAL) decides; queued input throws WardError secret_value_multiline (new catalog entry, validation, hint points at --stdin), and the existing finally drains and flushes before echo returns. An empty or Ctrl-C read is not judged as a paste. AC3 wording: no docs page for secret set exists in this checkout (docs/ holds ADRs, runbooks and security-tests only), so the pointer is in the manifest's secret summary (what ward help secret prints) and the error hint; the plugin skill was not touched. Evidence: bun run check green (1162 pass); real-pty scenarios in test/pty-residue.test.ts now expect REFUSED:secret_value_multiline for both the short and the past-the-queue paste with nothing reaching the shell, and a new one-line scenario still reads LEN:6.
